captions: A blockchain address is like a glass mailbox.
Anyone can watch every payment Ada gets.
Stealth addresses fix this. Ada never shares a mailbox.
She mixes a secret colour with a common one, and shares the mix.
Sam wants to pay Ada. He picks a secret colour too.
He mixes it with Ada’s shared colour.
That mix makes a brand-new mailbox, just for this payment.
He pins a hint on a public board: his secret, mixed with the common colour.
To find it, Ada mixes each hint with her secret.
Only her secret recreates Sam’s mix, so only she finds it.
Anyone else mixes the wrong colours and gets nowhere.
Only Ada’s key, with that same mix, can open it.
A helper pays the network fee, so the new mailbox never needs gas.
Every payment gets a new mailbox. Only Ada can find them.
